summary: Mobile-friendly /basvuru wizard verified on 390x844 end-to-end and 1920x800 desktop regression. All 4 steps reached with ZERO horizontal scroll (documentElement.scrollWidth == innerWidth == 390 on every step and no visible overflow-x scrollable element with overflow). Step strip is a proper 2x2 grid on mobile (grid-template-columns '162px 162px') with 4 wizard-step-item-* tiles; wizard-progress-label shows 'ADIM n / 4' and wizard-progress-text updates '%25/%50/%75/%100 tamamlandi' correctly across steps. Sticky mobile-action-bar is fixed at bottom (position:fixed, bottom:0, z-index:40) on every step, shows 'Vize sec' before a visa is picked and mobile-action-bar-total = '5.190 TL' after selecting the first visa option; mobile-next-step-button (h=48) advances through steps 1-3; on step 4 mobile-pay-button ('Odemeye gec') is rendered and mobile-next-step-button is hidden. WhatsApp social-dock sits at y=700-748 while bar top is 771 so no overlap. Empty-form submit shows in-form toast 'Eksik: Adiniz Soyadiniz ve 7 alan daha · ilk eksige goturduk', page scrolls to first invalid field and inline red errors ('Adinizi ve soyadinizi yazin.', 'Gecerli bir e-posta adresi girin.', etc.) appear under each missing input. Input keyboard hints all correct: input-contact-email type=email/inputMode=email/autoComplete=email; input-contact-name autoComplete=name + autoCapitalize=characters; traveler-0-first/last-name + passport-no autoCapitalize=characters; traveler-0-birth-date and passport-expiry inputMode=numeric. UploadExamplesHint on traveler-0-passport-examples and traveler-0-photo-examples renders 4 thumbnails in class 'grid grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 sm:flex' (proper 2x2 on mobile). AI passport OCR ran, populated AHMET ORNEK/U000000000 and photo AI accepted the ok.jpg portrait, letting the flow advance to step 2 -> primary-visa-select (5 options, picked 30 Gunluk Tek Girisli 5.190 TL) -> arrival/departure dates typed as gg.aa.yyyy -> step 3 Ek Hizmetler -> step 4 Ozet ve odeme. Desktop regression at 1920x800: step strip is single flex row, mobile-action-bar is NOT visible, wizard-next-step-button is visible/clickable, dock sits at x=1768/y=666 in normal bottom-right position, docSW==1920. Only two touch-target misses found (see below); everything else meets the spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Calendar-icon buttons are 36px tall on mobile (traveler-0-birth-date-calendar-button, traveler-0-passport-expiry-calendar-button, input-arrival-date-calendar-button, input-departure-date-calendar-button all measured height=36). Spec required ~44px touch targets. Width was bumped to w-11 but height was not. Bump the button to h-11 on mobile (currently likely h-9).
traveler-0-type-adult and traveler-0-type-child are 40px tall on mobile (spec asks ~44). Consider h-11 on mobile.

action_items: In DateField.jsx bump the calendar trigger button to h-11 (44px) on mobile so all 4 date pickers (birth, passport expiry, arrival, departure) meet the 44px touch-target requirement. Currently only width was widened to w-11.
In the traveler-type toggle (Yetiskin/Cocuk) bump min-height to h-11 on mobile (currently 40px).

mobile-action-bar z-index=40 and SocialDock bottom-24 on /basvuru correctly prevents overlap - verified live.
